framed.title: Framed - A Noir-Inspired Puzzle Adventure
framed.slogan: Rearrange, Strategize, and Unravel the Mystery
framed.description: Dive into Framed, an intriguing puzzle game that blends storytelling with strategic thinking. In this noir-inspired adventure, players navigate through a thrilling narrative by rearranging comic book panels. With its captivating gameplay and mysterious atmosphere, Framed offers a unique experience that challenges your mind and keeps you engaged. Play Framed now and uncover the secrets hidden within each panel!
